name: Clear Standby List
description: Clears cached memory pages that Windows normally reuses, which can help troubleshoot stutters after long gaming sessions or heavy multitasking. Note: This does not permanently increase FPS and Windows will rebuild the cache automatically.

description_i18n.en: Clears cached memory pages that Windows normally reuses, which can help troubleshoot stutters after long gaming sessions or heavy multitasking. Note: This does not permanently increase FPS and Windows will rebuild the cache automatically.
description_i18n.de: Leert zwischengespeicherte Speicherseiten, die Windows normalerweise wiederverwendet, was helfen kann, Stutter nach langen Gaming-Sessions oder starkem Multitasking zu beheben. Hinweis: Dies erhöht nicht dauerhaft den FPS und Windows baut den Cache automatisch neu auf.
description_i18n.fr: Vide les pages mémoire mises en cache que Windows réutilise normalement, ce qui peut aider à diagnostiquer des saccades après de longues sessions de jeu ou un multitâche intensif. Note : Cela n'augmente pas durablement le FPS et Windows reconstruit automatiquement le cache.

warnings.title: Cache rebuild delay
warnings.message: Windows will automatically rebuild memory caches during normal use. Running this too often can cause temporary slowdowns as data is loaded again from disk

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: This action requests the operating system to empty the standby page list via a direct memory management call, releasing cached pages back to available RAM without closing applications or changing permanent settings
